description:
DENISE PACINI is a Brazilian-founded, Miami-based jewelry brand created for women who lead with confidence and presence.

The brand is known for its bold, sculptural, statement silhouettes that blend organic movement with architectural strength. Every piece is designed to transform an outfit instantly elevating even the simplest look into something powerful and unforgettable.

Rooted in Brazilian craftsmanship and refined through a global fashion lens, DENISE PACINI delivers runway-impact jewelry with accessible luxury positioning.

OUR PRODUCTS

We specialize in:

  • Statement Earrings – Lightweight, maxi silhouettes engineered for impact without discomfort

  • Gold-Plated Jewelry – High-quality 18K gold-plated brass with premium finishing

  • Sculptural Designs – Organic curves, fluid lines, and distinctive shapes

  • Fashion-Forward Collections – Designed to photograph beautifully and stand out in editorial, social media, and retail environments

Each piece is:
✔ Designed in-house
✔ Produced in Brazil
✔ Stocked in Miami for fast shipping
✔ Crafted to balance bold design with wearability

WHAT MAKES DENISE PACINI DIFFERENT

1. Instant Visual Identity
Recognizable, empowered silhouettes that stand out in a crowded market.

2. Lightweight Statement Engineering
Large-scale designs that feel surprisingly light.

3. Empowerment Positioning
More than jewelry — each piece represents confidence, femininity, and the power of self-expression.

How Affiliates Earn with DENISE PACINI ✨

Earn 20% Commission on Every Sale

When you join the DENISE PACINI Affiliate Program, you earn 20% commission on every sale generated through your unique link or code.

That means:

  • ✔ 20% of the total order value

  • ✔ No cap on earnings

  • ✔ The more you sell, the more you earn

How It Works

  1. Apply to join our Affiliate Program

  2. Once approved, you will be gifted 2–3 hero statement pieces to produce content.

  3. Receive your personal tracking link or discount code

  4. Share DENISE PACINI jewelry with your audience

  5. Earn 20% commission on every completed purchase made through your link

Why It’s Attractive for Affiliates 

  • High average order value (statement pieces drive larger carts)

  • Strong visual appeal for Instagram & TikTok

  • Luxury positioning with accessible pricing

  • Fast shipping from Miami

  • Empowered, confident brand identity that resonates with fashion-driven audiences


How to promote us:

Everything you post should reinforce:

  • Statement Jewelry that feels good as it looks.

  • Jewelry that Speaks before you do: Brings you Confidence.

  • Your Jewelry should do more than complete an outfit, it should express who you are.

  • Heavy on Style. Light on the ears.

  • Smart Luxury. Demi-Fine jewelry made to last.

  • Luxury isn't about paying more, its about choosing better.

  • 18K Gold Plated Jewelry, with premium finish, durability and everyday comfort.

Not just “pretty jewelry.”

🎥 B. Reels That Convert

Content ideas:

  • “How to elevate a basic outfit”

  • “From simple to powerful in 5 seconds”

  • Styling 1 earring 3 different outfits

  • GRWM with statement jewelry

  • Close-up movement videos

Jewelry sells when it MOVES.
